title: ‘I didn’t notice his body being purple’: Byron Bay doula left newborn to inflate a jumping castle, court hears
summary_full: Inquest into deaths of four babies born in free births or at home in northern NSW between 2022 and 2024 hears ‘something was seriously wrong’Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastBaby DH was born in an inflatable pool, in a candle-lit room in his parents’ home near Byron Bay, with no one medically trained present. There are two very different versions of what happened next.In the parents’ version, the doula reassured them Baby DH was OK, then left to inflate a jumping castle while their newborn turned purple, became floppy, and struggled to breathe. In the doula’s version, everything seemed OK but she suggested they seek more help if they wanted to. Continue reading...
